text: .aee/dependency-inventory.json — Dependency Analyzer output; JSON array of all declared dependencies with fields: manifest, lineRange, name, version, component, ecosystem, scope, advisories; empty array when no manifests found

.aee/dependency-advisories.json — Dependency Analyzer output; filtered subset of dependency-inventory.json containing only entries with at least one advisory match, sorted by severity (critical first)

.aee/dependency-summary.md — human-readable Dependency Analyzer summary: Manifest Inventory table, Advisory Matches table, Unpinned Dependencies table, Notes section; notes 'zero manifests found' when repository has no pom.xml/requirements.txt/package.json/go.mod
